domain_title: Models, agents, providers, tools and supply chain
title: Model, agent and component inventory
canonical_definition: Models, agents, prompts, tools, APIs, datasets, providers, infrastructure, versions and owners are registered and linked to the assessed system.

conditions: All AI systems, including externally hosted and embedded AI components.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are all material AI and supporting components, versions, configurations, owners and roles inventoried?
Is inventory capture integrated with build, deployment, routing and change processes?
Can a specific run, decision or incident be reconstructed from the component baseline actually used?

capability_indicators: Model and prompt versions are traceable

conditions: Refer a material failure of model, agent and component inventory to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.6 (PDF p. 28), MAP 4.2 (PDF p. 32), MANAGE 3.2 (PDF p. 37)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on maintaining AI inventory and monitoring dependencies and pre-trained models. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make model, agent and component inventory verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: C1 evaluates model, agent and component inventory using evidence from intent through operation. AP-C1 independently assesses evidence of shadow ai component usage.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a versioned inventory of models, agents, tools, prompts, routing, providers, owners and configuration baselines. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates build and deployment admission against inventory, including effective runtime routing and fallback identity capture. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides reconstruction of sampled runs from immutable component identifiers, including a fallback or recent version change. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in model, agent and component inventory, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a versioned inventory of models, agents, tools, prompts, routing, providers, owners and configuration baselines. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate build and deployment admission against inventory, including effective runtime routing and fallback identity capture. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide reconstruction of sampled runs from immutable component identifiers, including a fallback or recent version change. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how model, agent and component inventory works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a versioned inventory of models, agents, tools, prompts, routing, providers, owners and configuration baselines. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use reconstruction of sampled runs from immutable component identifiers, including a fallback or recent version change to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: A provider model alias can be documented when the effective deployment identity and its limitations remain traceable.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-C1 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in model, agent and component inventory
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in model, agent and component inventory
Evidence remains insufficient for model, agent and component inventory in the assessed scope
